Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
This is the fourth poll of the "problematic" cards.

After we had a decent discussion about Lilith's Blessing now comes the poll. There were arguments against the card and for the card. Please read through those arguments and make your decision about wether and in what way the card should be changed in your opinion.

Lilith's Blessing
Master
[1 Pool]
Master.
Put this card in play. As a master phase action, you may tap this card to search your library for a master: Discipline card and choose a ready non-Bahari vampire you control who has no blood. That vampire gains the Discipline card (if any) and 3 blood and becomes Bahari.

The poll is up for three weeks from now on. Please tell everybody about it so we can get a most significant result out of a broad participation.

Please keep in mind that the result however is the opinion of all participants which does not mean it is that of all players.

Furthermore the outcome of this poll does not necessarily mean something changes or stays the same.

Baron of Frankfurt

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Non-existant user wrote:
> Why are they 2 different options? Losing one's title is a consequence of changing sects.
>
Ankha makes the point that some titles aren't sect-bound.

Additionally, if you're a Sabbat Archbishop and lose your title, you can still benefit from Sabbat-specific effects. If the "lose your title" is also a one-time effect, you could also regain a new title more easily. e.g. I could play Regent on my not-an-Archbiship-anymore Bahari vampire.

Messages.Author: Wedge
Messages.Body:
From what I am told Bahari are Pariah in the vampire communities (WoD RPG).
How about...

A titled non-Bahari vampire can take a  action to make a Bahari vampire Red List.

and

Any (non-bahari?) vampire can call a vote to make a Bahari vampire Red List.

This does not change card text in any way nor does it give a way to exploit the change, unless you think Rebirth is just that good.
